description: This file defines the implementation of the CookieOptions class and its nested SameSiteCookieContext class, including methods for managing cookie context types, equality operators, and a static method to create an inclusive cookie options configuration.

classes.name: CookieOptions
classes.description: Represents options for cookie handling, including context types and flags.

classes.name: CookieOptions::SameSiteCookieContext
classes.description: Encapsulates the context for SameSite cookie policies, including methods to create inclusive contexts and retrieve context metadata.

methods.name: CookieOptions::SameSiteCookieContext::MakeInclusive
methods.description: Creates a SameSiteCookieContext with strict same-site context.

methods.name: CookieOptions::SameSiteCookieContext::MakeInclusiveForSet
methods.description: Creates a SameSiteCookieContext with lax same-site context for setting cookies.

methods.name: CookieOptions::SameSiteCookieContext::GetContextForCookieInclusion
methods.description: Returns the appropriate context for cookie inclusion based on schemeful mode.

methods.name: CookieOptions::SameSiteCookieContext::GetMetadataForCurrentSchemefulMode
methods.description: Returns metadata for the current schemeful mode.

methods.name: CookieOptions::SameSiteCookieContext::SetContextTypesForTesting
methods.description: Sets context types for testing purposes.

methods.name: CookieOptions::SameSiteCookieContext::CompleteEquivalenceForTesting
methods.description: Checks if this context is equivalent to another for testing.

methods.name: CookieOptions::CookieOptions
methods.description: Default constructor initializing with cross-site context.

methods.name: CookieOptions::MakeAllInclusive
methods.description: Creates a CookieOptions object with all inclusive settings.
